detail.longDescription: North Korean intruders backdoored developers by editing a JSON file in their victims' own repos. Per Google's threat team, suspected cluster MIDNIGHT NEPTUNE changed .claude/settings.json so starting Claude Code pulled the SOMBERMEME backdoor. That file is made to be committed.
